description: Internal Audit function responsible for annual KYC procedure testing, sample testing of completed KYC files, verification of compliance with documentation standards, and assessment of escalation handling appropriateness.
context: Annual KYC procedure testing (see [[departments]] Internal Audit)
Sample testing of completed KYC files

name: FCA/PRA
description: External regulatory authorities conducting periodic examinations and thematic reviews of KYC effectiveness, including file sampling and assessment as part of regulatory audit obligations.

name: Policy Review and Update Framework
description: A governance framework establishing the schedule and triggers for reviewing and updating banking policies. The policy mandates annual reviews or reviews triggered by regulatory changes, with documented review dates and regulatory change monitoring mechanisms.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon regulatory change)
Regulatory Change Triggers: FCA COBS rule changes, Money Laundering Regulations updates, Court judgments affecting KYC, Guidance from regulatory authorities

name: Annual Policy Review Requirement
description: A mandatory requirement that policies be reviewed on an annual basis, or more frequently if triggered by regulatory changes. This provision establishes the baseline review cadence for all policies.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon regulatory change)

name: Regulatory Change Trigger Review
description: A mandatory requirement to conduct policy reviews whenever regulatory changes occur, including FCA COBS rule changes, Money Laundering Regulations updates, court judgments affecting KYC, or guidance from regulatory authorities. This provision ensures policies remain compliant with evolving regulatory requirements.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon regulatory change)
Regulatory Change Triggers: FCA COBS rule changes, Money Laundering Regulations updates, Court judgments affecting KYC, Guidance from regulatory authorities

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: The primary UK financial regulator whose COBS (Conduct of Business) rules and regulatory guidance trigger policy review and update obligations. FCA rule changes are identified as a key regulatory change trigger.

name: Money Laundering Regulations
description: UK anti-money laundering legislation that establishes compliance obligations for financial institutions. Updates to these regulations trigger mandatory policy reviews.

name: Know Your Customer Court Judgments
description: Court judgments that affect Know Your Customer requirements and obligations. Such judgments are identified as regulatory change triggers requiring policy review.

name: Regulatory Authority Guidance
description: Formal guidance issued by regulatory authorities that establishes or clarifies compliance expectations. Such guidance triggers mandatory policy review and update processes.

name: Money Laundering Risk
description: The risk of customer accounts and transactions being used for money laundering purposes. This risk category is addressed through policy review triggers tied to Money Laundering Regulations updates.

name: Know Your Customer Compliance Risk
description: The risk of non-compliance with Know Your Customer requirements and the evolving legal standards governing customer identity verification. Court judgments affecting KYC are identified as regulatory change triggers.

name: Regulatory Compliance Risk
description: The risk of non-compliance with FCA COBS rules and other regulatory requirements. This risk is mitigated through regular policy reviews triggered by regulatory changes.

name: Anti-Money Laundering Policy
description: A formal policy document governing anti-money laundering compliance obligations and procedures within the organization. Referenced as a key policy framework for financial crime prevention.

name: Document Retention Policy
description: A formal policy document establishing requirements and standards for the retention, storage, and lifecycle management of documents within the organization.

name: KYC Verification
description: The Know Your Customer identity and verification process as defined in organizational procedures and referenced in the business ontology. Establishes standards for customer due diligence at account opening and ongoing compliance.

name: Identification Document
description: Official identity documents required and accepted by the organization for KYC purposes, subject to internal guidance standards and document retention policies.

name: Compliance Department
description: The organizational department responsible for oversight and implementation of compliance policies, including KYC verification, AML procedures, and document retention standards.

name: Account Opening
description: The process and procedures governing the establishment of new customer accounts, subject to KYC verification requirements and documented in the Account Opening SOP.

name: Know Your Customer Policy
description: A compliance policy governing customer identity verification and due diligence procedures. The policy has undergone multiple revisions, with the most recent version (2.1) adding risk-based re-verification schedules and Enhanced Due Diligence procedures as of 2026-01-15.
context: Version 2.1 | 2026-01-15 | Added risk-based re-verification schedule, EDD procedures
Version 2.0 | 2025-07-01 | Annual review, updated PEP screening procedures

name: Risk-Based Re-Verification Schedule
description: A mandatory requirement to conduct periodic re-verification of customer identity and information based on assessed risk levels. This provision was introduced in policy version 2.1 effective 2026-01-15.
context: Added risk-based re-verification schedule, EDD procedures

name: Enhanced Due Diligence Procedures
